title: Two weeks of weekday wake-ups on the weekend
hypothesis: If I get up within 30 minutes of my weekday time on Saturday and Sunday, weekend sleep moves from 5.9 h toward the weekday 6.3 h. Bedtimes differ by about 23 minutes (median 1:04 am on weekends, 12:42 am on weekdays), so most of the missing time is at the morning end, which is the end a wake-up rule controls.
why: It targets the clearest effect that one simple rule can reach, and it costs nothing to run.
protocol: Weekday alarm time on Saturday and Sunday, within 30 minutes
Lights out by 12:30 on Friday and Saturday nights
Wearable on every night, no manual edits

checkin.q: Up within 30 minutes of my weekday time?

success: Across the four weekend nights, average sleep within 0.3 h of the weekday average (6.3 h), with no weekday night shortened to pay for it.
